messages:
felix.k: Quick flag - today's midday emit shows a handful of invoices with missing GPU compute rows, PDF sent but totals low. example inv_03111t (nimbus).
tara.m: Which emitter ran? standard-day or the "low-latency" flow?
felix.k: low-latency `ll-2026-07-08-11z`. Logs indicate emit happened at 11:02:03 and the usage-merge finished at 11:02:05.
billing-bot: Alert: batch ll-2026-07-08-11z -> 7 invoices missing sku compute.gpu, 2 invoices with duplicate S3 uploads for same invoice key. Report -> s3://billing/alerts/2965432100.json
nick.r: PDF duplicates usually mean pdf-worker retried after a 502 and re-uploaded. We'll add an s3 idempotency token.
support: Any customers already reached out? We'll queue outreach if we reissue.
felix.k: No inbound tickets yet. Proposed plan: pause outbound email for this batch, run dry reconcile: `billingctl reconcile --batch ll-2026-07-08-11z --dry --out /tmp/dry-2965432100.csv`.
tara.m: Threshold for auto-approve re-emit is $7,500 change per finance policy. Above that route to finance.
billing-bot: Dry-run started. Preliminary: 7 affected, deltas range -$25 to +$4,900.
finance: If all deltas <= $7,500 we approve automated backfill+re-emit with no-customer-email first for QA.
felix.k: Ok I'll run backfill for the 7 and re-emit with `--no-email` then post logs. Will also open PR for pdf-worker idempotency.
support: I'll draft templates in /docs/support/reissue-ll-2026-07-08.md and standby for notice.
